lines.text: The support schedule now brings planning, requests, and technician updates together. Start on the board. The three links at the top open the month calendar, requests and approvals, and your scheduling inbox.

Open Month calendar for the wider view. Filter by technician, shift, or assignment location. Published assignments appear in blue. Schedule builders also see drafts in amber; technicians only see published schedules.

On Who's on, open Add to Outlook and choose an individual technician. Copy that link and subscribe from web in Outlook. Add each technician separately, then show or hide their calendars in Outlook. Outlook controls refresh timing.

To reuse a schedule, select New schedule, choose the new start date, and pick an earlier schedule under Start from. Unanswered availability carries into the draft with review warnings. Known unavailability and rule conflicts stay open. Locations are left blank for review.

Open Availability deadline and reminders. Set the deadline and enable automatic reminders if needed. At nine A M Eastern, reminders go only to technicians with unanswered days. Remind missing respondents lets you send a reminder yourself.

Before publishing, open Workload and publishing review. Compare hours, days, and untimed entries, then inspect coverage gaps and availability warnings. Resolve assignment conflicts, confirm any remaining warnings, and publish the reviewed schedule.

Technicians use Requests and approvals for time off or shift swaps. A swap needs the other technician's acceptance before a schedule builder approves it. Time-off approval shows how many assigned shifts would be removed, so you can plan replacement coverage.

Published shift changes create an update for each affected technician to acknowledge. Back on the board, Change history and acknowledgments keeps the previous and current shifts, who made the change, and whether the technician acknowledged it.

For notifications from technicians, open Scheduling inbox. Availability responses and approval requests appear here. Turn on Email alerts to receive new updates at your account email. Emails are grouped and checked every five minutes; the inbox keeps every update.

Use the board to plan and publish, Requests and approvals for decisions, and Scheduling inbox for responses. The month calendar and individual Outlook subscriptions give you the wider view, with the latest published schedule always available on Who's on.
